title: Awesome American Onion Casserole
description: A grassy, tender, and festive American dish featuring chopped onion in a mother-sauce-base, perfect for any occasion, and shojin-friendly for a guilt-free meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, sauté the chopped onions in butter until they are tender and lightly browned.
In a separate saucepan, whisk together the mushroom broth and flour to make a mother sauce, and cook until it thickens.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked onions, mother sauce, salt, and black pepper, and stir until well combined.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange a layer of the onion mixture, followed by a layer of grated cheddar cheese.
Repeat the layers until all the ingredients are used, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top layer of cheese.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
